import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
# Based on Data Overview, use nested paths
train_path = "input/train/train.json"
test_path = "input/test/test.json"

try:
    with open(train_path, "r") as f:
        train_data = json.load(f)
    with open(test_path, "r") as f:
        test_data = json.load(f)
except FileNotFoundError:
    # Fallback if paths differ slightly based on environment
    with open("input/train.json", "r") as f:
        train_data = json.load(f)
    with open("input/test.json", "r") as f:
        test_data = json.load(f)

df_train = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
df_test = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Feature Selection
# Numerical features available in both train and test based on schema
num_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

# Text features
# Combine title and edit_aware text
df_train["request_text_combined"] = (
    df_train["request_title"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + df_train["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
)
df_test["request_text_combined"] = (
    df_test["request_title"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + df_test["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
)

# Prepare data
X_train = df_train[num_features].copy()
y_train = df_train["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

X_test = df_test[num_features].copy()
ids_test = df_test["request_id"]

# Split for validation (Stratified)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Text Vectorization
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=3000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english")
X_tr_text = tfidf.fit_transform(X_tr["request_text_combined"])
X_val_text = tfidf.transform(X_val["request_text_combined"])
X_test_text = tfidf.transform(X_test["request_text_combined"])

# Drop text column from numerical frames
X_tr_num = X_tr.drop("request_text_combined", axis=1).values
X_val_num = X_val.drop("request_text_combined", axis=1).values
X_test_num = X_test.drop("request_text_combined", axis=1).values

# Convert numerical to sparse
X_tr_num_sparse = csr_matrix(X_tr_num)
X_val_num_sparse = csr_matrix(X_val_num)
X_test_num_sparse = csr_matrix(X_test_num)

# Combine features
X_tr_final = hstack([X_tr_num_sparse, X_tr_text])
X_val_final = hstack([X_val_num_sparse, X_val_text])
X_test_final = hstack([X_test_num_sparse, X_test_text])

# Model: XGBoost
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="auc",
    use_label_encoder=False,
)

# Train on validation split
model.fit(X_tr_final, y_tr)

# Validate
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_final)[:, 1]
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_score:.4f}")

# Retrain on full training data for submission
X_train_full_text = tfidf.transform(X_train["request_text_combined"])
X_train_full_num = X_train.drop("request_text_combined", axis=1).values
X_train_full_num_sparse = csr_matrix(X_train_full_num)
X_train_full_final = hstack([X_train_full_num_sparse, X_train_full_text])

model.fit(X_train_full_final, y_train)

# Predict on test
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test_final)[:, 1]

# Save Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": ids_test, "requester_received_pizza": test_preds}
)
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
